besluite.fout: The possessive opener "'n Kantoor se briewe is met die hand geskryf" is stiff.
besluite.rede: The locative "In 'n kantoor is briewe" is the natural Afrikaans opening, costs one word and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: "die woord" has no antecedent; the sentence before speaks of 'n fout, not a word.
besluite.rede: "die verkeerde woord" pairs cleanly with "die regte een" and removes a stumble for one word, with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: "dit is waar ... vandaan kom" copies English and can first be misread as "dit is waar" (that is true).
besluite.rede: "daarvandaan kom die naam QWERTY" is idiomatic, shorter and keeps QWERTY intact; the comma stays correct because both clauses have their own subject and verb.

besluite.fout: "elke letter het presies dieselfde vorm gehad" is imprecise: same as what, as if all letters shared one shape.
besluite.rede: "elke keer" states what the reason actually means (a letter always printed the same) without adding a fact, for two words.
"Nuwe werk het bygekom" is grammatical, natural Afrikaans; adding "daar" is a lateral move that spends a word in a list item.
In context "'n tweede brief oorgeskryf" clearly means making a copy, and the proposal adds words and swaps oorgeskryf for uitgeskryf, breaking its echo with "oorgeskryf" at the end of the paragraph.
A perfect tense after "sonder dat" with a present main clause is normal Afrikaans, and "hoef" shifts the sense from not having copied to not needing to copy.

besluite.fout: "is vandag nog by ons" copies English "is still with us".
besluite.rede: "Ons gebruik die QWERTY-uitleg vandag nog" is plain natural Afrikaans, one word shorter, with the same meaning and QWERTY unchanged.
